info.name: ProofChain API
info.description:
Deterministic end-to-end exercise of the complete approved ProofChain 1.0.0 HTTP surface.

Run the folders in declared order: every module depends on identifiers captured by the previous one. Runtime values (bearer tokens, generated identifiers, synthetic evidence bytes) are written to collection variables at run time and are never persisted into this file.

Preconditions and the pinned Newman command are documented in postman/README.md.

item.name: 05 Evidence registration
item.description: Registers one digital evidence from synthetic bytes generated in the pre-request script. No binary fixture is tracked and no local file path is referenced.

exec: // Synthetic evidence bytes: every ASCII code point except CR and LF, repeated. The payload deliberately contains NUL
// and control bytes so upload/download parity is proven over a genuinely binary body, while staying byte-identical
// under the UTF-8 encoding Newman and Postman apply to a raw request body.
